verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a general Xero accounting API, SDKs and an official MCP server covering contacts, Chart of Accounts and invoices. Nothing documents creating manual journal entries via the API, saving them as drafts, or placing them in an accountant review queue. The draft bills 'ready for approval' come from AI bill extraction, a different feature, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant
